title: [v0.91.8][WP-21] Accept Memory Palace ADR after ready proof
body:
Closes #5007

## Summary
- Adds ADR 0058 accepting Memory Palace as the deterministic long-running context handoff packet layer.
- Grounds the decision in #4760's ready PR #5740 proof at head 94156d55d0a1f4bfda7ce32ac136437520325906.
- Updates the ADR index and v0.91.8 ADR plan to point at ADR 0058 while preserving the earlier deferred ADR 0051 boundary.
- Records a proof-to-claim table and #5007 lifecycle evidence.

## Proof Boundary
- #5740 is ready/non-draft evidence for #4760, not a merge or closeout claim.
- #4760 remains separate runtime proof scope; this PR records the #5007 ADR decision outcome only.
- This branch does not claim Memory Palace is merged to main.
